name: Pollard Banknote Limited
summary: Pollard Banknote Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of lottery and charitable gaming products and solutions in the United States, Canada, and internationally. It produces and provides a range of instant tickets and lottery services, including licensed products; distribution; interactive digital internet games, such as eInstants; iLottery services comprising platform and player account management software through Catalyst brand; loyalty and engagement programs; marketing; and instant ticket vending machines.
